report:
Fresh followup review of meta.reviews.selector_test. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh, read the complete claim and all five test bodies, recaptured prior fixture helpers (review.rs tests lines 1–103) and review design. Compared every previous/current fragment by path/selector and association metadata. The sole change is a placeholder_status association comment in review.rs; implementation/test metadata, claim, test bodies, correspondence source, helpers and design are unchanged. No fragments were removed. The comment does not affect the complete prior assessment, which I reassessed as follows.

Both ordinary implementation associations are necessary and present: correspondence.rs function extraction and review.rs Selector::Test selection. Correspondence builds package identity, kind:name target identity and fully qualified Rust path, preserving a shared file independently per target. Function extraction records item.span(), including attributes/signature/body and internal comments from original source; byte_span converts parsed positions into source byte ranges. Annotated module-level standard tests are admitted by record_tests. Selector::Test matches package, target and Rust path plus the fragment's resolved source file, deduplicates repeated associations to the same span, and requires exactly one span before slicing original text. inventory records complete function fragments without requiring the containing file, constructs identity-only Selector::Test values without line/byte offsets and rejects conflicting identities across anchors. input_errors compares initial captures and reselects added test reads; unchanged function text/identity therefore survives unrelated preceding lines. Essential extraction and resolution helpers are covered by the two associated whole files.

All five tests provide concrete evidence. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement asserts package/target/nested path/file/cfg/status and exact capture equality with TEST, whose fixture visibly includes attributes, signature, internal comment and assertion body; approval remains valid after unrelated leading lines but becomes invalid after cfg changes. This fixture has a separate implementation file, so its test fragment does not depend on a whole test-file snapshot. test_selectors_disambiguate_identical_paths_by_cargo_target creates two targets sharing a physical file, asserts distinct targets and exact selection in each, then rejects a wrong package. another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity captures another anchor's test exactly and then checks body changes, renamed/missing identity, and ambiguous alternatives reject recording without an output file; unchanged initial context cannot hide stale additional reads. ambiguous_initial_test_selector_cannot_be_recorded_as_complete_context prevents two cfg-separated spans under the same identity from becoming completed review context. ambiguous_test_identity_across_anchors_is_rejected requires start to reject the corresponding conflict split across two anchors. These assertions cover complete text, identity disambiguation, positional independence and stale/ambiguous identity rejection.

There are no TODO or N/A implementation/test entries for this anchor. No missing requirement or behavioral defect was identified in the comment-only delta or full claim accounting. Executed review start/read and capture comparisons, followed by record; no source edits, tests, formatting or workspace build were performed in this followup. Historical execution in the previous report was not treated as new execution. No requested edits.
